source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 6 ki exercise (PDF 135-138) ka hal; MCQs ki key chapter se, sawalon ke model jawab aur numericals qadam ba qadam.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 6 (Heat and Thermodynamics) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, constructed response aur comprehensive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) hain; numericals mein Given, formula, qeematein aur jawab unit ke saath line ba line likhe hain. Jahan zaroorat hai "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai, aur kitab ki ghaltiyan "Kitab ki ghalti" box mein.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
6.1 In an isothermal change, internal energy:
(Isothermal tabdeeli mein internal energy:)
blocks.explanation: Isothermal process mein temperature constant rehta hai. Ideal gas ki internal energy sirf temperature par depend karti hai, is liye ΔU = 0 aur Q = W (6.4).

blocks.prompt:
6.2 First law of thermodynamics is based upon law of conservation of:
(Thermodynamics ka pehla qanoon kis cheez ke conservation par mabni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Q = ΔU + W: system ko di gayi heat internal energy ke izafe aur kiye gaye kaam mein badal jati hai. Yeh energy ke conservation ka qanoon hai (6.4).

blocks.prompt:
6.3 A device which converts mechanical energy into heat energy is called:
(Woh aala jo mechanical energy ko heat energy mein badalta hai kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Heat engine (aur Carnot engine) heat ko kaam mein badalta hai, aur turbine mechanical kaam deta hai. Refrigerator ulta chalta hai: us par kaam W kiya jata hai aur heat Q_H = Q_C + W bahar di jati hai (6.9).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Asal mein refrigerator mechanical energy ko heat mein "badalta" nahi; woh kaam le kar heat ko thandi jagah se garam jagah le jata hai (yeh kaam bhi aakhir mein garam taraf heat ban jata hai). Diye gaye options mein (c) hi murad hai.

blocks.prompt:
6.4 When two objects are made in thermal contact having same temperature, then they are at:
(Ek jaise temperature wali do cheezein thermal contact mein hon to woh kis halat mein hain?)
blocks.explanation: Ek jaise temperature wali cheezon ke darmiyan net heat flow nahi hota, is liye woh thermal equilibrium mein hain (6.1).

blocks.prompt:
6.5 When the system is expanded by adding heat energy, then the work done will be:
(Heat de kar system phailaya jaye to kaam kaisa hoga?)

options.text: positive aur system ki taraf se
negative aur system ki taraf se

blocks.explanation: Phailti gas piston ko bahar dhakelti hai, is liye kaam system karta hai; sign convention ke mutabiq yeh kaam positive hai (W = PΔV, ΔV > 0).

blocks.prompt:
6.6 Entropy of a system in reversible process:
(Reversible process mein system ki entropy:)
blocks.explanation: Reversible process mein entropy constant rehti hai (6.11), yani entropy ki tabdeeli zero hai. Irreversible process mein entropy barhti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein "constant rehti hai" ka option nahi. Reversible process mein entropy khud zero nahi hoti, balke kul entropy ki tabdeeli (ΔS) zero hoti hai; isi mani mein (d) liya gaya hai.

blocks.prompt:
6.7 What happens to internal energy of an object when its temperature:
(Jab cheez ka temperature [barhta hai] to us ki internal energy ka kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ideal gas ki internal energy temperature ke directly proportional hai (average K.E. = 3/2 k_B T), is liye temperature barhne se internal energy barhti hai (6.2).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal adhoora chhapa hai ("when its temperature:"). Isay "jab temperature barhe" parha gaya hai; tab internal energy barhti hai (c).

blocks.prompt:
6.8 The value of Boltzmann constant is:
(Boltzmann constant ki qeemat kya hai?)

6.9 In an adiabatic process, there is no:
(Adiabatic process mein kya nahi hota?)
blocks.explanation: Adiabatic process mein koi heat system mein na aati hai na jati hai (Q = 0), is liye W = −ΔU; temperature badalta hai.

blocks.prompt:
6.10 Thermodynamics mostly deals with:
(Thermodynamics zyada tar kis cheez se mutalliq hai?)

options.text: heat ka energy ki doosri shaklon mein badalna

blocks.explanation: Thermodynamics physics ki woh shaakh hai jo heat aur energy ki doosri shaklon ke talluq aur un ke aapas mein badalne se mutalliq hai (6.1).

blocks.prompt:
6.1 What is meant by thermal equilibrium? Explain briefly.
Thermal equilibrium se kya muraad hai? Mukhtasar bataein.
blocks.explanation:
Thermal contact mein do cheezein thermal equilibrium mein hoti hain jab un ka temperature barabar ho aur un ke darmiyan heat ka net flow na ho.
Misal: garam coffee mein chamach heat leta hai jab tak dono ka temperature barabar na ho jaye; phir heat ka flow ruk jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
6.2 What is meant by internal energy? How is it related to temperature of an ideal gas?
Internal energy se kya muraad hai? Ideal gas ke temperature se is ka kya talluq hai?
blocks.explanation:
Internal energy kisi cheez ke molecules ki tamaam energies (kinetic aur potential) ka majmua hai.
Ideal gas ke molecules mein aapas ki forces nahi hoti, is liye us ki internal energy sirf molecules ki translational K.E. hai. Average K.E. = 3/2 k_B T, is liye ideal gas ki internal energy absolute temperature ke directly proportional hai (U ∝ T).

blocks.prompt:
6.3 State 2nd law of thermodynamics in two different form.
Thermodynamics ka doosra qanoon do mukhtalif shaklon mein bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Kelvin ka bayan: aisa koi process mumkin nahi jo ek hi reservoir se li gayi heat ko poora ka poora kaam mein badal de aur working system mein koi tabdeeli na chhore.
2. Entropy ki shakal mein: system koi qudrati process kare to woh us simt mein jata hai jis mein system aur mahol ki kul entropy barhe.
(Clausius ka bayan, chapter ke alfaaz se bahar: heat khud ba khud thandi cheez se garam cheez ki taraf nahi jati.)

blocks.prompt:
6.4 Is it possible to construct a heat engine of 100% efficiency? Explain.
Kya 100% efficiency wala heat engine banana mumkin hai? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Ideal Carnot engine ki efficiency bhi η = 1 − T₂/T₁ hai, jo 100% sirf tab ho jab thanda reservoir absolute zero (T₂ = 0 K) par ho, jo mumkin nahi. Doosre qanoon (Kelvin) ke mutabiq kuch heat hamesha thande sink ko deni parti hai; asal engines mein friction se bhi energy zaya hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
6.5 Differentiate between reversible and irreversible processes.
Reversible aur irreversible processes mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Reversible process bilkul ulti tarteeb se wapas chalaya ja sakta hai; irreversible nahi.

rows: Bilkul ulti tarteeb se wapas chal sakta hai, mahol mein koi tabdeeli nahi
Controlling factors ulte karne se bhi wapas nahi chalta
Wahi marahil (stages) ulte; har stage par heat aur kaam ke asraat bilkul ulte
Bohat aahista hota hai (har stage par equilibrium)
Achanak hota hai, ya friction/heat ka nuqsan shamil
System aur mahol ki entropy constant
System aur mahol ki entropy barhti hai
Misal: aahista evaporation/liquefaction, gas ka aahista compression
Misal: dhamaka, friction, garam aur thanda pani milana

blocks.prompt:
6.6 Why adiabate is steeper than isotherm? Explain.
Adiabat isotherm se zyada dhalwan (steep) kyun hota hai? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation:
Isotherm ke liye PV = constant, magar adiabat ke liye PV^γ = constant, jahan γ > 1.
Adiabatic expansion mein heat nahi di jati, is liye gas apni internal energy se kaam karti hai aur us ka temperature bhi girta hai. Is liye volume ke barabar izafe par pressure isothermal (temperature constant) ke muqable mein zyada girta hai, aur adiabatic curve zyada dhalwan hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
6.7 A refrigerator transforms heat from cold to hot body. Does this violate the second law of thermodynamics? Justify your answer.
Refrigerator heat ko thandi se garam cheez ki taraf le jata hai. Kya yeh doosre qanoon ki khilaf warzi hai? Daleel dein.
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Doosra qanoon kehta hai ke heat khud ba khud thandi se garam cheez ki taraf nahi jati. Refrigerator yeh khud nahi karta: us par bahar se kaam W (compressor, bijli ki energy) kiya jata hai, aur garam mahol ko di gayi heat Q_H = Q_C + W hai. Mahol ki entropy andar ki kami se zyada barh jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
6.8 Explain briefly heat death of universe in terms of entropy.
Entropy ke hawale se kainat (universe) ki heat death mukhtasar bataein.
blocks.explanation: (Yeh istilah chapter se bahar hai; 6.11 par mabni.) Har qudrati process mein kainat ki entropy barhti hai aur energy aisi thermal energy ban jati hai jo kaam nahi kar sakti. Aakhir mein poori kainat ka temperature ek jaisa ho jayega (zyada se zyada entropy); temperature ka farq na hone se heat kaam mein nahi badlegi aur sab processes ruk jayenge. Is aakhri halat ko kainat ki heat death kehte hain.

blocks.prompt:
6.9 Is it possible for a cyclic reversible heat engine to absorb heat at constant temperature and transforms it completely into work without rejecting some heat at low temperature? Explain.
Kya cyclic reversible heat engine ek hi temperature par heat le kar, kam temperature par kuch heat chhore baghair, poori ko kaam mein badal sakta hai? Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Doosre qanoon ke Kelvin bayan ke mutabiq ek hi reservoir ki heat cycle mein poori kaam mein nahi badal sakti. Heat engine ko garam source aur thande sink ke darmiyan chalna aur sink ko kuch heat Q₂ deni parti hai, is liye W = Q₁ − Q₂ < Q₁ aur η = 1 − T₂/T₁ < 1.

blocks.prompt:
6.10 How does behaviour of real gases differ from ideal gas at high pressure and low temperature? Identify the reasons behind these differences based on kinetic theory of gases.
Zyada pressure aur kam temperature par real gases ka rawaiya ideal gas se kaise mukhtalif hai? Kinetic theory ki buniyad par wajahein bataein.
blocks.explanation:
Zyada pressure aur kam temperature par real gases PV = nRT follow nahi karti; ideal rawaiye se hat jati hain (ideal rawaiya sirf kam pressure aur zyada temperature par).
Wajahein (kinetic theory ke mafrooze toot jate hain): (i) molecules qareeb aa jate hain, is liye un ka apna volume bartan ke volume ke muqable mein nazar-andaz nahi kiya ja sakta; (ii) molecules ki aapas ki kashish (attractive forces) nazar-andaz nahi rehti, aahista molecules ek doosre ko khenchte hain aur deewar par pressure kam ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
6.11 Show that area under P-V graph is equal to work done.
Dikhayein ke P-V graph ke neeche ka area kiye gaye kaam ke barabar hai.
blocks.explanation:
Pressure P par gas area A wale piston ko Δy dhakelti hai: W = FΔy = PAΔy = PΔV.
Constant pressure par P-V graph mein V₁ aur V₂ ke darmiyan line ke neeche rectangle hai jis ki oonchai P aur chaurai (V₂ − V₁) = ΔV hai, is liye area = PΔV = W. Agar P badle to area ko patli patiyon (strips) mein baantein, har ek PΔV; in sab ka majmua (curve ke neeche kul area) kul kaam hai.

blocks.prompt:
6.12 How is work done (i) by a gas (ii) on a gas? Calculate.
Gas (i) khud kaam kaise karti hai (ii) gas par kaam kaise hota hai? Hisaab lagayein.
blocks.explanation:
Kaam W = PΔV.
(i) Gas ka kaam: gas phaile (ΔV > 0) aur piston ko bahar dhakele to woh mahol par kaam karti hai; W = PΔV positive.
(ii) Gas par kaam: bahar ki force gas ko dabaye (ΔV < 0) to gas par kaam hota hai; W = PΔV negative.
Misal: 8000 N m⁻² par 4.0 × 10⁻³ m³ phailne wali gas W = 8000 × 4.0 × 10⁻³ = 32 J kaam karti hai (Example 6.2).

blocks.prompt:
6.1 Explain how thermodynamics relates to the concept of energy conservation.
Wazahat karein ke thermodynamics ka energy ke conservation se kya talluq hai.
blocks.explanation:
Thermodynamics ka pehla qanoon, Q = ΔU + W, heat aur kaam par lagaya gaya energy ke conservation ka qanoon hai: system ko di gayi heat us ki internal energy ke izafe aur us ke kiye gaye kaam mein badal jati hai. Energy sirf shakal badalti hai (chemical → thermal → mechanical); isolated system ki kul energy constant rehti hai.
Misalein:
• Isothermal process: ΔU = 0, is liye Q = W (saari heat kaam ban jati hai).
• Adiabatic process: Q = 0, is liye W = −ΔU (kaam internal energy se).
• Heat engine ka cycle: ΔU = 0, is liye W = Q₁ − Q₂.
• Bicycle pump: hawa par kiya gaya kaam us ki internal energy aur temperature barhata hai.
Yeh qanoon chemical, electrical aur nuclear samet har process par lagu hai.

blocks.prompt:
6.2 Explain how thermodynamics applies to biological systems, such as human body.
Wazahat karein ke thermodynamics biological systems, jaise insani jism, par kaise lagu hoti hai.
blocks.explanation:
Jism mein energy badalne wale processes ko metabolism kehte hain, aur un par pehla qanoon lagu hai: ΔU = Q − W.
• Chalne, daurne ya harkat mein jism kaam W karta hai; barhne aur mare hue cells badalne ke liye bhi energy chahiye. Is se jism ki internal energy (jama chemical energy) kam hoti hai.
• Jism heat Q bhi mahol ko deta hai (paseena, saans, radiation), jis se internal energy aur kam hoti hai.
• Khurak chemical energy deti hai jo internal energy wapas poori karti aur jism ka temperature constant rakhti hai.
Yani jism energy paida nahi karta; khurak ki energy kaam aur heat mein badalti hai. (Chapter se bahar: doosre qanoon ke mutabiq jism apni tarteeb sirf is tarah qaim rakhta hai ke heat chhor kar mahol ki entropy barhaye.)

blocks.prompt:
6.3 A gas is expanding adiabatically. Explain what happens to temperature and pressure of the the gas.
Gas adiabatically phail rahi hai. Gas ke temperature aur pressure ka kya hota hai?
blocks.explanation:
Adiabatic expansion mein na heat aati hai na jati hai (Q = 0), is liye pehle qanoon se W = −ΔU.
Temperature: gas apni internal energy se mahol par kaam karti hai, is liye internal energy kam hoti hai aur temperature girta hai.
Pressure: pressure kam hota hai, kyun ke volume barhta hai aur temperature bhi girta hai; yeh PV^γ = constant follow karta hai, is liye isothermal ke muqable mein tezi se girta hai (adiabat zyada dhalwan).
Misal: phate tyre se nikalti hawa thandi lagti hai; oopar uthti hawa thandi ho kar badal banati hai.

blocks.prompt:
6.4 A coffee cup is left on a table, and overtime coffee cup cools down. Explain thermodynamics processes occurring during this process.
Coffee ka cup mez par chhora gaya aur waqt ke saath thanda ho gaya. Is dauran hone wale thermodynamic processes bataein.
blocks.explanation:
• Heat transfer: coffee mahol se garam hai, is liye heat coffee se cup, mez aur hawa ki taraf conduction, convection (garam hawa ka uthna) aur radiation se jati hai; surface se evaporation bhi heat le jata hai.
• Pehla qanoon: kaam taqreeban nahi hota (W ≈ 0), is liye ΔU = Q; heat bahar jati hai (Q negative), coffee ki internal energy aur temperature kam hote hain.
• Doosra qanoon aur entropy: heat khud sirf garam se thande ki taraf jati hai; yeh irreversible process hai. Coffee ki entropy kam hoti hai (−Q/T_garam), magar mahol ki zyada barhti hai (+Q/T_thanda), is liye kul entropy barhti hai.
• Thermal equilibrium: coffee kamre ke temperature tak thandi hoti rehti hai; phir net heat flow ruk jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
6.5 How we can explain different weather patterns through thermodymical processes like wind, rain, etc.
Hawa, barish waghera jaise mausam ke patterns ko thermodynamic processes se kaise samjhayenge?
blocks.explanation:
(Zyada tar chapter se bahar; heat transfer aur adiabatic tabdeeli ke chapter wale tasawwur istemal hote hain.)
• Hawa (wind): sooraj zameen, samandar aur hawa ko barabar garam nahi karta. Garam hawa phailti, halki hoti aur oopar uthti hai (convection), peechhe kam pressure chhorti hai; zyada pressure wali thandi bhari hawa us ki jagah lene aati hai. Yahi hawa ka chalna hai (din mein sea breeze, raat ko land breeze).
• Badal aur barish: oopar uthti nam hawa oonchai par pressure kam hone se adiabatically phailti hai, is liye thandi hoti hai (W = −ΔU). Bukharat (water vapour) qatron mein badal kar badal banate hain aur latent heat dete hain; qatre bare hon to barish (ya thand ho to barf/ole) girti hai. Badal banna chapter mein di gayi adiabatic process ki misal hai.
• Samandar se evaporation heat jazb karta aur hawa mein nami dalta hai, jis se water cycle chalta hai.
Yani heat transfer, adiabatic expansion aur state ki tabdeeli mil kar hawa, badal aur barish banate hain.

blocks.prompt:
6.1 What are the postulates of kinetic theory of gases? Derive a relation for ideal gas equation in the form PV=NkT from general gas equation.
Kinetic theory of gases ke mafrooze (postulates) kya hain? General gas equation se ideal gas equation PV = NkT derive karein.
blocks.explanation:
Kinetic theory of gases ke mafrooze:
1. Gas ke molecules musalsal be-tarteeb (random) harkat mein hain aur seedhi lines mein chalte hain jab tak aapas mein ya deewar se na takrayen.
2. Molecules ka apna volume gas ke volume ke muqable mein nazar-andaz kiya ja sakta hai (point masses).
3. Takkar ke ilawa molecules ke darmiyan koi kashish ya dhakelne wali force nahi.
4. Molecules ki aapas mein aur deewar se takkarein poori tarah elastic hain (K.E. zaya nahi hoti).
5. Gas mein bohat zyada molecules hote hain, is liye statistical tareeqe istemal hote hain.
6. Molecules ki average K.E. absolute temperature ke directly proportional hai.
7. Gas ka pressure molecules ke deewar se takrane ki wajah se hai.
8. Takkar ka waqt do takkaron ke darmiyani waqt ke muqable mein nazar-andaz kiya ja sakta hai.

PV = Nk_BT ka derivation:
General (ideal) gas equation: PV = nRT ...(i)
Moles ki tadaad n = N/N_A, jahan N molecules ki tadaad aur N_A = 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹ ...(ii)
(ii) ko (i) mein rakhein: PV = (N/N_A)RT = N(R/N_A)T ...(iii)
R/N_A ki nisbat Boltzmann constant hai:
k_B = R/N_A = 8.3145/(6.02 × 10²³) = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹
Is liye PV = Nk_BT
Yeh Boltzmann constant ki shakal mein ideal gas equation hai.

blocks.prompt:
6.2 State and explain various gas laws.
Mukhtalif gas laws bayan karein aur samjhayein.
blocks.explanation:
Gas laws fixed mass wali ideal gas ke pressure P, volume V aur temperature T ka talluq batate hain: ek cheez constant rakh kar baqi do badalte hain.

1. Boyle's law (1662): constant temperature par fixed mass gas ka pressure volume ke inversely proportional hai.
P ∝ 1/V, ya PV = constant, ya P₁V₁ = P₂V₂
Graph: P aur V ka graph curve (hyperbola) hai jo (P₁, V₁) se (P₂, V₂) tak girta hai (Fig. 6.1).

2. Charles' law: constant pressure par gas ka volume absolute temperature ke directly proportional hai.
V ∝ T, ya V/T = constant, ya V₁/T₁ = V₂/T₂
Graph: V aur T ka graph seedhi line hai jo peechhe barhane par −273 °C (0 K) par temperature axis se milti hai (Fig. 6.2).

3. Gay-Lussac's law: constant volume par fixed mass gas ka pressure absolute temperature ke directly proportional hai.
P ∝ T, ya P/T = constant, ya P₁/T₁ = P₂/T₂
Graph: P aur T ka graph origin se guzarti seedhi line hai (Fig. 6.3).

In qawaneen ko mila kar general (ideal) gas equation PV = nRT (R = 8.3145 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹) ya PV = Nk_BT banti hai. Real gases yeh qawaneen sirf kam pressure aur zyada temperature par theek follow karti hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhein: Boyle = T constant (P aur V ulte), Charles = P constant (V aur T saath saath), Gay-Lussac = V constant (P aur T saath saath). Charles aur Gay-Lussac mein temperature hamesha kelvin mein lein.

blocks.prompt:
6.3 Explain first law of thermodynamics in detail. Give an example in support of your explanation. Give its two applications.
Thermodynamics ka pehla qanoon tafseel se samjhayein, misal dein aur is ke do applications bataein.
blocks.explanation:
Bayan: kisi bhi thermodynamic process mein jab system ko heat Q di jaye to yeh energy system ki internal energy ke izafe ΔU aur system ke mahol par kiye gaye kaam W ki shakal mein zahir hoti hai.
Q = ΔU + W, ya ΔU = Q − W
Wazahat:
• Heat dene se internal energy barhti hai (temperature, pressure barhta hai ya state badalti hai). Agar saath hi gas phaile to heat ka kuch hissa mahol par kaam W = PΔV karne mein lagta hai.
• Sign convention: system mein aane wali heat +Q, jane wali −Q; system ka kiya kaam +W, system par kiya kaam −W.
• ΔU sirf shuru aur aakhri halat par depend karti hai (internal energy state function hai).
• Pehla qanoon energy ke conservation ka qanoon hai: energy shakal badalti hai magar isolated system ki kul energy constant rehti hai. Yeh chemical, electrical aur nuclear processes par bhi lagu hai.

Misal: gas 42 J heat leti hai aur 8000 N m⁻² par ΔV = 0.10 m² × 4.0 × 10⁻² m = 4.0 × 10⁻³ m³ phailti hai. W = PΔV = 32 J, is liye ΔU = Q − W = 42 J − 32 J = 10 J (Example 6.2). Doosri misal: bicycle pump tezi se chalane par garam ho jata hai kyun ke hawa par kiya gaya kaam us ki internal energy barhata hai.

Applications:
1. Isothermal process (T constant): ideal gas mein ΔU = 0, is liye Q = W; saari di gayi heat kaam mein lagti hai (aahista expansion).
2. Adiabatic process (heat ka len den nahi): Q = 0, is liye W = −ΔU; adiabatic expansion mein gas thandi hoti hai (phata tyre, badal banna), aur adiabatic compression mein garam.
(Aur: insani metabolism, ΔU = Q − W, jahan khurak kaam aur heat mein kharch hone wali internal energy wapas deti hai.)

blocks.prompt:
6.4 What is a refrigerator? Explain its working. Derive an expression for its co-efficient of performance.
Refrigerator kya hai? Is ka kaam samjhayein aur coefficient of performance ka expression derive karein.
blocks.explanation:
Refrigerator: woh aala jo kisi cheez ka temperature mahol se kam rakhta hai. Yeh ulta chalne wala heat engine hai.

Kaam:
• Yeh kam temperature reservoir (LTR, andar ka khana) se heat Q_C leta aur zyada temperature reservoir (HTR, mahol) ko heat Q_H deta hai.
• Heat khud thande se garam ki taraf nahi jati (doosre qanoon ka Clausius bayan), is liye compressor bijli ki energy se system par bahar ka kaam W karta hai.
• (Chapter se bahar: refrigerant liquid andar ke coils mein evaporate ho kar heat jazb karta hai; compressor vapour ko dabata hai jo peechhe ke coils mein condense ho kar kamre ko heat deta hai; phir wapas phail kar andar ke coils mein jata hai.)
• Energy ke conservation se: Q_C + W = Q_H, ya W = Q_H − Q_C
Refrigerator mein system par kaam hota hai, jab ke heat engine mein system khud kaam karta hai.

Co-efficient of performance:
LTR se nikali gayi heat (Q_C) aur kiye gaye kaam (W) ki nisbat:
E = Q_C/W
W = Q_H − Q_C rakhein:
E = Q_C/(Q_H − Q_C)
Ideal refrigerator mein Q ∝ T (kelvin). T₁ thanda aur T₂ garam temperature (kitab ki notation):
E = T₁/(T₂ − T₁)
Achha refrigerator kam kaam mein zyada heat nikalta hai, yani us ka E zyada hota hai. Example 6.4: E = 8 aur T₁ = 250 K se 8 = 250/(T₂ − 250), is liye T₂ = 281.25 K.

blocks.prompt:
6.5 What is Carnot engine? Describe Carnot cycle. State Carnot theorem and derive an expression for efficiency of Carnot engine.
Carnot engine kya hai? Carnot cycle bayan karein. Carnot theorem bataein aur Carnot engine ki efficiency ka expression derive karein.
blocks.explanation:
Carnot engine: Sadi Carnot (1824) ka bayan kiya hua ideal heat engine jo do heat reservoirs ke darmiyan sirf isothermal aur adiabatic processes wale ideal reversible cycle mein chalta hai. Yeh sab se zyada efficient mumkin engine hai.

Carnot cycle (ideal gas, P-V diagram ABCDA):
1. A→B, T₁ par isothermal expansion: gas garam reservoir se heat Q₁ leti hai.
2. B→C, adiabatic expansion: temperature T₁ se T₂ tak girta hai.
3. C→D, T₂ par isothermal compression: gas thande reservoir ko heat Q₂ deti hai.
4. D→A, adiabatic compression: gas T₁ par apni pehli halat mein wapas aati hai.
Har waqt thermal aur mechanical equilibrium rehta hai, is liye har qadam reversible hai. Ek cycle ka net kaam ABCDA ke andar ka area hai.

Efficiency:
Gas pehli halat mein wapas aati hai, is liye ΔU = 0. Net li gayi heat Q = Q₁ − Q₂. Pehle qanoon Q = ΔU + W se:
W = Q₁ − Q₂
η = output kaam/input energy = W/Q₁
η = (Q₁ − Q₂)/Q₁ = 1 − Q₂/Q₁
Isothermal processes mein heat kelvin temperature ke proportional hai, is liye Q₂/Q₁ = T₂/T₁:
η = 1 − T₂/T₁ = (T₁ − T₂)/T₁
Percentage efficiency = (1 − T₂/T₁) × 100
Efficiency sirf do temperatures par depend karti hai, working substance par nahi; 100% sirf T₂ = 0 K par, jo namumkin hai. Example 6.3: T₁ = 700 K, T₂ = 350 K se η = 50%.

Carnot's theorem: koi heat engine unhi do temperatures ke darmiyan chalne wale Carnot engine se zyada efficient nahi ho sakta. Wasee bayan: unhi do temperatures ke darmiyan chalne wale tamaam Carnot engines ki efficiency barabar hai, working substance koi bhi ho.

blocks.prompt:
6.5 Define and explain the term "Entropy".
"Entropy" ki tareef aur wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation:
Tareef: entropy S ek state variable hai (Clausius, 1856) jo doosre qanoon ko adadi buniyad deta hai. Agar system reversible process mein absolute temperature T par heat ΔQ le to us ki entropy ki tabdeeli
ΔS = ΔQ/T (unit J K⁻¹)
Potential ya internal energy ki tarah sirf entropy ki tabdeeli aham hai.

Wazahat:
• Heat dene par ΔS positive aur heat nikalne par negative hai.
• Jab heat Q, T₁ wale reservoir se T₂ wale (T₁ > T₂) ki taraf jaye, garam wala Q/T₁ khota aur thanda Q/T₂ pata hai. Q/T₂ > Q/T₁, is liye net tabdeeli (Q/T₂ − Q/T₁) positive hai. Yani har qudrati process mein kul entropy barhti hai.
• Entropy ki shakal mein doosra qanoon: qudrati process us simt mein jata hai jis mein system aur mahol ki entropy barhe. Reversible process mein entropy constant, irreversible mein barhti hai.
• Entropy aur be-tarteebi: qudrati processes zyada be-tarteebi (disorder) ki taraf jate hain (garam se thande heat, heat dena, gas ka free expansion), is liye entropy molecular be-tarteebi ka paimana hai.
• Energy ka degradation: entropy ke har izafe se kuch energy kaam ke qabil nahi rehti (mila hua garam aur thanda pani dobara alag nahi hota). Kainat ki entropy hamesha barhti hai.
Example 6.5: 0 °C par 1.0 kg barf pighalne par ΔS = mL_f/T = (1.0 × 3.36 × 10⁵)/273 = 1.23 × 10³ J K⁻¹.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Aakhri do comprehensive sawalon par dono dafa 6.5 chhapa hai; entropy wala sawal chhatha (6.6) hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Entropy ko be-tarteebi samjhein: taash ke patte phentne (shuffle) se be-tarteeb hote hain, khud ba khud tarteeb mein nahi aate. Qudrat bhi isi tarah zyada be-tarteebi (zyada entropy) ki taraf jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
6.1 A 2.5 g sample of an unknown gas is placed in a 25.0 L container at 300 K. The pressure of the gas is measured to be 8.21 atm. Calculate molar mass of unknown gas. (Ans: 37.6 g mol⁻¹)
2.5 g na-maloom gas 300 K par 25.0 L bartan mein hai aur us ka pressure 8.21 atm hai. Gas ka molar mass maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: m = 2.5 g, V = 25.0 L, T = 300 K, P = 8.21 atm, R = 0.0821 L atm mol⁻¹ K⁻¹ (= 8.3145 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹)
Maloom karna: molar mass M = ?
Formula: PV = nRT = (m/M)RT, is liye M = mRT/(PV)
Qeematein: M = (2.5 g × 0.0821 L atm mol⁻¹ K⁻¹ × 300 K)/(8.21 atm × 25.0 L)
M = 61.575/205.25 g mol⁻¹
M = 0.300 g mol⁻¹
(SI mein: P = 8.21 × 101,325 Pa = 8.32 × 10⁵ Pa, V = 0.025 m³; n = PV/RT = 8.34 mol; M = 2.5 g/8.34 mol = 0.300 g mol⁻¹.)
Jawab: chhape hue data se M = 0.300 g mol⁻¹.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab 37.6 g mol⁻¹ chhapti hai jo diye gaye data se nahi nikalta: 2.5 g, 25.0 L, 300 K aur 8.21 atm se M = mRT/(PV) = 0.300 g mol⁻¹ (8.34 mol gas) aata hai. Yeh hydrogen (2 g mol⁻¹) se bhi kam hai, yani chhapa hua data aapas mein mel nahi khata; 37.6 g mol⁻¹ ke liye pressure taqreeban 0.0655 atm (ya mass kahin zyada) hona chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
6.2 A gas occupies 6.0 L of volume at a pressure of 12 atm. What will be the volume of gas if the pressure is increased by 2.0 atm, assuming that temperature remains constant. (Ans: 3.6 L)
Gas 12 atm pressure par 6.0 L volume gherti hai. Temperature constant rakh kar pressure 2.0 atm barha diya jaye to volume kya hoga?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: V₁ = 6.0 L, P₁ = 12 atm, pressure 2.0 atm barha, is liye P₂ = 12 + 2.0 = 14 atm; T constant
Maloom karna: V₂ = ?
Formula (Boyle's law): P₁V₁ = P₂V₂, is liye V₂ = P₁V₁/P₂
Qeematein: V₂ = (12 atm × 6.0 L)/14 atm
V₂ = 72/14 L
V₂ = 5.14 L
Jawab: V₂ ≈ 5.1 L.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab 3.6 L chhapti hai. 12 atm mein 2.0 atm barhane se 14 atm aur V₂ = 72/14 = 5.14 L banta hai. Kitab ka 3.6 L = 72/20 hai, yani tab jab pressure 20 atm tak (8.0 atm) barhaya jata.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: "Increased by 2.0 atm" ka matlab hai 2.0 atm izafa (12 + 2 = 14 atm), "increased to" nahi. Boyle's law mein pressure barhe to volume usi nisbat se kam hota hai: 12/14 hissa, yani 6.0 × 12/14 = 5.14 L.

blocks.prompt:
6.3 A gas undergoes a thermodynamic process where it absorbs 500 J of heat energy and performs 300 J work on its surroundings. Calculate the change in internal energy of the gas. (Ans: 200 J)
Gas 500 J heat leti hai aur mahol par 300 J kaam karti hai. Gas ki internal energy mein tabdeeli maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: Q = +500 J (li gayi heat), W = +300 J (gas ka kaam)
Maloom karna: ΔU = ?
Formula (pehla qanoon): Q = ΔU + W, is liye ΔU = Q − W
Qeematein: ΔU = 500 J − 300 J
ΔU = 200 J
Jawab: internal energy 200 J barhti hai (kitab ke mutabiq).

blocks.prompt:
6.4 A Carnot engine is operating between a high temperature reservoir at 600 K and a low temperature reservoir at 300 K. Calculate:
(i) the maximum possible efficiency
(ii) the amount of work output if the engine absorbs 500 J of heat from the high temperature reservoir. (Ans: 50%, 250 J)
Carnot engine 600 K aur 300 K ke reservoirs ke darmiyan chal raha hai. (i) zyada se zyada efficiency (ii) 500 J heat lene par kaam maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: T₁ = 600 K, T₂ = 300 K, Q₁ = 500 J
Maloom karna: (i) η = ? (ii) W = ?
(i) Formula: η = 1 − T₂/T₁
η = 1 − 300 K/600 K = 1 − 0.5 = 0.5
η = 0.5 × 100 = 50%
(ii) Formula: η = W/Q₁, is liye W = ηQ₁
W = 0.5 × 500 J
W = 250 J
(Chhori gayi heat Q₂ = Q₁ − W = 250 J.)
Jawab: (i) 50% (ii) 250 J (kitab ke mutabiq).

blocks.prompt:
6.5 A refrigerator extracts 1200 J of heat from its interior (the cold reservoir and releases 1800 J of heat to the surrounding environment) (the hot reservoir) during each cycle. Calculate:
(i) the work input required per cycle.
(ii) the co-efficient of performance (COP) of the refrigerator. (Ans: 600 J, 2)
Refrigerator har cycle mein andar se 1200 J heat nikalta aur mahol ko 1800 J deta hai. (i) har cycle ka zaroori kaam (ii) COP maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: Q_C = 1200 J, Q_H = 1800 J
Maloom karna: (i) W = ? (ii) E (COP) = ?
(i) Formula: Q_C + W = Q_H, is liye W = Q_H − Q_C
W = 1800 J − 1200 J
W = 600 J
(ii) Formula: E = Q_C/W
E = 1200 J/600 J
E = 2 (koi unit nahi)
Jawab: (i) har cycle 600 J (ii) COP = 2 (kitab ke mutabiq).

blocks.prompt:
6.6 Calculate the entropy change when 1.0 mole of ice at 0 °C melts to form liquid water at the same temperature. (Ans: 22.0 J K⁻¹)
0 °C par 1.0 mole barf usi temperature par pighal kar pani banti hai. Entropy ki tabdeeli maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: n = 1.0 mol barf, pani ka molar mass = 18 g mol⁻¹, is liye m = 18 g = 0.018 kg
T = 0 °C = 273 K
Barf ki latent heat of fusion L_f = 3.36 × 10⁵ J kg⁻¹ (Example 6.5 wali)
Maloom karna: ΔS = ?
Formula: ΔS = ΔQ/T = mL_f/T
Li gayi heat: ΔQ = 0.018 kg × 3.36 × 10⁵ J kg⁻¹ = 6048 J
ΔS = 6048 J/273 K
ΔS = 22.2 J K⁻¹
Jawab: ΔS ≈ 22.2 J K⁻¹ (entropy barhti hai). Kitab ka 22.0 J K⁻¹ aam qeemat L_f = 3.33 × 10⁵ J kg⁻¹ se aata hai (0.018 × 3.33 × 10⁵/273 = 21.96 ≈ 22.0 J K⁻¹).

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Sawal mein mass nahi, moles diye hain. Pehle moles ko mass mein badlein: 1 mole pani = 18 g = 0.018 kg. Phir ΔS = mL_f/T lagayen; temperature hamesha kelvin mein (0 °C = 273 K).

blocks.prompt:
6.7 A gas occupies 400 mL at 20 °C. What volume will it occupy at 80 °C, assuming constant pressure? (Ans: 482 mL)
Gas 20 °C par 400 mL gherti hai. Constant pressure par 80 °C par us ka volume kya hoga?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: V₁ = 400 mL, T₁ = 20 °C = 20 + 273 = 293 K, T₂ = 80 °C = 80 + 273 = 353 K; pressure constant
Maloom karna: V₂ = ?
Formula (Charles' law): V₁/T₁ = V₂/T₂, is liye V₂ = V₁T₂/T₁
Qeematein: V₂ = 400 mL × 353 K/293 K
V₂ = 400 × 1.205 mL
V₂ = 481.9 mL ≈ 482 mL
Jawab: 482 mL (kitab ke mutabiq).

blocks.prompt:
6.8 A gas has a pressure of 2 atm at 300 K. What pressure will it have at 450 K, assuming constant volume? (Ans: 3 atm)
Gas ka pressure 300 K par 2 atm hai. Constant volume par 450 K par pressure kya hoga?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: P₁ = 2 atm, T₁ = 300 K, T₂ = 450 K; volume constant
Maloom karna: P₂ = ?
Formula (Gay-Lussac's law): P₁/T₁ = P₂/T₂, is liye P₂ = P₁T₂/T₁
Qeematein: P₂ = 2 atm × 450 K/300 K
P₂ = 2 × 1.5 atm
P₂ = 3 atm
Jawab: 3 atm (kitab ke mutabiq).
